title: Cross-validate: sign in A, verify in B/C
notes:
2026-08-25 cross-interop blocker: Python/PyNaCl and Rust verify every fixed link_frame_signed_modes.json signature and reject component/signature mutations. Existing C primitive schnorr48_verify also verified all 6 canonical preimage/signature pairs in a ctypes run, proving core Schnorr interoperability. But C schnorr48_verify_frame rejected all 6 (generic=True, frame=0 each). Root cause in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/schnorr48.c:282-380 and 385-475: signer_iid/signer_iid_len are [[maybe_unused]], frame hashing starts at LENGTH with header||payload, omitting mandatory LICHEN-LINK-v1\0 domain and 8-byte signer EUI-64. Header contract claims signer coverage at include/lichen/schnorr48.h:129-131 but implementation contradicts it. The only C cross-language frame oracle is disabled at lichen/tests/schnorr48/main.c:502-607/633-634. Standalone existing C suite passes because it tests the same stale self-consistent helper. Current phase forbids C production edits, so cannot close until C frame transcript is corrected and the fixed-vector C consumer is enabled for all address modes/tamper cases.
2026-08-26 read-only re-evaluation: C/Zephyr blocker remains unchanged. In lichen/subsys/lichen/link/schnorr48.c:282-380 and :385-475, signer_iid/signer_iid_len are still [[maybe_unused]]; the nonce and challenge hash only privkey/R/pubkey + length/LLSec/epoch/seq/destination + payload. The mandatory LICHEN-LINK-v1\0 domain and SI-present 8-byte signer EUI-64 used by Python/Rust canonical link_frame_signed_modes.json signatures are still absent. lichen/tests/schnorr48/main.c:502-607 keeps test_signed_frame_cross_language_oracle under #if 0 and the runner still comments it out. Therefore the stale C helper can only pass self-consistent C round trips and cannot verify Python/Rust canonical frames; exact cross-implementation gates were not rerun because source inspection proves the known incompatibility persists. C/Zephyr edits are excluded for this wave. Leave open/unclaimed until the C transcript is corrected and an enabled fixed-vector C consumer passes all address modes plus domain/signer/tamper negatives. No files modified.
2026-08-27 wave recheck: blocker remains source-identical. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/schnorr48.c marks signer_iid and signer_iid_len [[maybe_unused]] in the production frame sign/verify paths, while the public header requires the signer in the authenticated transcript. The mandatory LICHEN-LINK-v1\0 domain is absent from those paths. lichen/tests/schnorr48/main.c still wraps legacy calls with NULL/0 signer, keeps test_signed_frame_cross_language_oracle under #if 0, and does not invoke it. Thus current primitive/self-roundtrip harnesses cannot prove sign-in-A verify-in-B/C for canonical signed frames. No relevant files were dirty and no edits were made; released rather than altering schnorr48.c/shared vectors in this wave.
Completed genuine cross-implementation link-signature parity. Fixed lichen/subsys/lichen/link/schnorr48.c frame sign/verify transcript to include the mandatory 15-byte LICHEN-LINK-v1\0 domain and the exact 8-byte SIID when LLSec SI is set; malformed/null SIID inputs now fail closed. Added isolated host C consumer lichen/tests/schnorr48_interop for all six independently PyNaCl-generated link_frame_signed_modes.json vectors: C verifies every Python signature, C signing reproduces each canonical signature byte-for-byte (therefore the same bytes already verified by Python/Rust), and SIID mutation/malformed lengths are rejected. Validation: new UBSan C ctest 1/1 and executable 6/6; existing UBSan schnorr48 ctest 1/1; Python focused tests 40 passed; Rust lichen-link schnorr48_vectors 2/2 and shared_vectors 6/6 passed with unique CARGO_TARGET_DIR; git diff --check clean. No shared vectors or dirty legacy/general tests were modified.
